surgery.

3. Materials — Stainless steel. Designation 30Cr13 of Schedule V of IS: 1570-1961 'Schedules for 
wrought steels for general engineering purposes ' or of the following composition:

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4-1 All the surfaces shall be smooth and free from pits, cracks, burrs and other surface flaws. 

4.2 All the sharp edges, other than the cutting edge, shall be rounded. The cutting edge shall be sharp 
and even. 

4.3 The gouge shall be passivated and polished bright. 

5. Heat Treatment — The instrument shall be hardened and tempered to a hardness of 600 to 600 HV, 

6. Tests 

6.1 Performance Test — Apply the cutting edge of a gouge to the surface of seasoned teak wood. Make 
an effort to scoop the wood with the help of manual pressure. A piece shall be scooped out 
cleanly and easily. On completion of the test, the cutting edge shall neither chip nor show any sign of 
damage.

7, Marking — Each gouge shall be marked with the following:

8. Packing — Each gouge shall be put in a polyethylene bag and then packed in an individual cardboard
